subject: A resignation is not an apology, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

A Minister has resigned. Nothing else has changed.

Your Government turned up unannounced at farms across this state without invitation. Families were pressed on their own front steps. In one case staff brought security with them to lean on a farmer in his eighties about transmission lines - a project we don’t even need.

None of those families has had an apology. Not one.

The person who presided over it has left. Those laws are still on the books and the department still answers to your government and uses these same tricks. That makes it yours now.

I am asking you to do two things.

Apologise to every farming family your government targeted.

Order an independent investigation into how it was allowed to happen, and make the findings public.

I am not going away and neither are the farmers who lived through this.

Yours sincerely,

subject: You inherited this, Premier. Now own it.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

You are still responsible for it.

Farming families across this state had government staff arrive at their gates without warning or invitation. An elderly farmer had security standing there when they came to intimidate her about accepting transmission lines on her property. And when Greg Baldwin rang triple zero to report trespassers on his own land, he was the one who ended up charged.

On 27 April 2026 the Director of Public Prosecutions withdrew every single charge against him. Not some of them. All of them. No explanation given, then or since.

A resignation does not fix any of that.

Apologise to the families your government went after.

Order an independent investigation and make the findings public.

That is the minimum, Premier, and it is well overdue.

Yours sincerely,

subject: An 80-year-old and a security escort. Explain that.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

I would like you to explain something to me.

Why did your Government think it was appropriate to send staff with a security escort to press a farmer in her eighties about VNI West?

She is not a threat to anybody. She was just a normal citizen who did not want a transmission line through her paddocks.

That was not an accident and it was not one bad day. Farms right across the state had people turn up unannounced who were never invited on.

A Minister has resigned since. Nobody has apologised to that lady, and nobody has explained the decision.

So I am asking you, as Premier, for two things. Apologise to every farming family your government targeted. And order an independent investigation into how it happened, with the findings made public.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Open the books, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

I want to know how a state government came to treat its own farmers with such disdain.

I don’t want another media statement. Not a review conducted by the guilty department. An independent investigation, with what it finds put in front of the public.

The record so far is uninvited visits to farms right across the state, security personnel brought along to press an elderly farmer about VNI West, and a farmer charged after he rang triple zero to report trespassers on his own property. Every one of those charges was withdrawn on 27 April 2026 without a word of explanation.

Somebody made those decisions. Somebody signed off on them. Farming families are entitled to know who, and why.

Apologise to the families involved, Premier, and open the books.

Yours sincerely,

subject: These families are owed an apology from you
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

There are farming families in this state who have not slept properly because of what your government did to them.

People turned up at their HOMES uninvited. Another farmer was charged for ringing triple zero on his own land, and then watched every charge quietly withdrawn without explanation offered.

Not one of them has received an apology.

Only you can deliver this apology.

Apologise to every farming family your government targeted, and order an independent investigation into how it was allowed to happen, with the findings made public. We must make sure this never happens again.

It costs you nothing to do the decent thing here, Premier.

Yours sincerely,

subject: He rang triple zero. He got charged.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

Greg Baldwin rang triple zero to report trespassers on his own property. He was the one who ended up charged.

On 27 April 2026 the Director of Public Prosecutions withdrew every single charge against him. Not reduced. Not settled. Withdrawn in full, without one word of explanation to him or to anybody else.

It’s like your Government was trying to instill fear into the citizens it was meant to serve.

His family carried those charges for months. Nobody has said sorry. Nobody has even acknowledged that anything went wrong.

That is a grave injustice and it did not happen in isolation. Farms across this state had even had security arrive at their door.

Premier, apologise to the families your government targeted. Order an independent investigation into how it happened and make the findings public.

Start with a phone call to the Baldwins.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Generations on this land. Then the government arrived.
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

Farming families have worked this country for generations - even 7 or 8 generations. They have dealt with drought, fire, bad markets and worse seasons. What they did not expect was their own government turning up at the gate uninvited to attack them.

That is what happened across this state. Unannounced visits to properties that never asked anyone on. A farmer charged after ringing triple zero on his own land, with every charge withdrawn on 27 April 2026 and no reason ever given.

One Minister has gone. The families are still waiting.

Apologise to them, Premier. Do the right thing.

Then order an independent investigation into how a government came to treat its own farmers this way, and make the findings public. Make sure this never happens again.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Silence is becoming the admission, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

Every day you say nothing about this, you are more guilty.

Farming families had government staff arrive at their properties without invitation. An elderly farmer was pressed about VNI West with a security escort in her home. A farmer who rang triple zero to report trespassers was charged, and every charge against him was withdrawn on 27 April 2026 without explanation.

Your government has not apologised for any of it. It has not explained any of it.

Silence reads as a position, Premier, and the position it reads as is that all of this was fine.

None of this is fine.

Apologise to the farming families your government targeted. Order an independent investigation with the findings made public.

Two things. Neither of them is hard.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Farmers think twice about calling the police now
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its department targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

Here is the damage your government has done that will outlast every one of us.

Greg Baldwin rang triple zero to report trespassers on his own land and he was the one charged. Every charge was withdrawn on 27 April 2026 without a word of explanation.

Farmers watched that happen. Now there are people out there who will not ring for help when strangers turn up on their property, because they saw what it cost the last bloke who did.

That is a serious trust to have broken, and it sits alongside the uninvited visits across the state.

Farms of 6 and 7 generations have now suffered at the hands of your Government.

Apologise to the families involved, Premier, and order an independent investigation with the findings made public. So that this never happens again.

Until you do, that fear stays exactly where your government put it.

Yours sincerely,

subject: Two things, Premier
body:
Dear Premier Carroll,

Your Government and its departments targeted farmers, and it’s time to come clean.

I will keep this short.

Government staff turned up unannounced at farms across this state that never invited them. Security was brought along to press a farmer in her eighties about VNI West. Greg Baldwin rang triple zero on his own property and was the one charged, and every charge was withdrawn on 27 April 2026 without explanation.

A Minister has resigned. That is not justice and it is not an apology.

Two things, Premier.

Apologise to every farming family your government targeted.

Order an independent investigation into how it was allowed to happen, and make the findings public. Make sure this never happens again.

I will keep asking until both are done.

Yours sincerely,
